text:
eva: Heads-up — seeing a sharp increase in 503s from hosted inference since the canary at ~08:12. Multiple customers opened tickets.

support-bot: 4 distinct customer reports so far: #C-112, #C-117, #C-120. Patterns: short lived requests (<= 1s) hitting gateway and returning 503.

sam: Oncall here. Any obvious config flips in the canary? which flags changed?

maria: Canary used new routing selector: scope_id -> 'slice-v2' and a binary toggle to enable kv-prefetch for that slice. I pushed the canary at 08:10.

kevin: Suspect shadowing: the new selector might be matching broader traffic due to backcompat in the selector parser. I can reproduce 503 locally when scope_id is partially matched.

ops-bot: Deploy metadata: deploy-id=deploy-2026-6529, canary=10%, flags=[kv_prefetch=true, selector=scope_id=slice-v2].

sam: Can you paste the failing request sample?

support-bot: Example from C-112 (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer tok_xxx
{"model":"rwdl-13b","input":"hello"}
```
Response headers: `x-gateway-route: /infer/slice-v`

kevin: That truncated `x-gateway-route` looks like selector partial match. If selector parsing treats `slice-v2` as prefix it might match `slice-v` endpoints.

maria: Confirmed — our canary used a glob-style selector by mistake (`scope_id~slice-v*`) when it should have been an exact match. That explains broad traffic matching.

sam: Priority — roll back the selector change and scale the canary to 0%. Can someone coordinate rollback?

eva: I'll notify support and customers that we're rolling back and investigating (ETA 10m).

ops-bot: Initiating rollout rollback: action=rollback, target=deploy-2026-6529, stage=canary->0%, started_by=kevin.

kevin: Running the rollback commands now:
```
# rollback to previous deploy
kubectl set image deploy/inference-runtime inference=redwood/inference:2026-6528
redwood-orchctl rollout undo deploy-2026-6529 --to-revision=6528
```

sam: After rollback, watch for 503 rate drop and customer confirmations. Also check trace sampling for 08:05-08:20 window to confirm route matches.

ops-bot: Rollback completed, canary traffic moved to 0% at 08:20.

maria: Patching selector config now to exact match and preparing a new canary plan with stricter test harness.

support-bot: Notifying customers of mitigation and opening follow-ups to validate service.

kev: Quick telemetry: 503 spike baseline -> 0.2% pre-deploy, peaked at 6.1% during canary, dropped to 0.3% post-rollback.

eva: Good. Next steps: postmortem, adjust selector linting in CI, add canary traffic shadowing guard so selectors must pass exact-match linter.

sam: Agreed. Assigning action items:
- maria: patch selector and re-deploy canary with 1% and canary smoke tests (due: today)
- kevin: write a regression test for selector parsing (due: tomorrow)
- eva: customer comms + incident summary (due: EOD)

eva: I'll draft the summary now and ping for reviews. Thanks all :thumbsup:
